summary: When a light diff is raised to standard (CRITICAL found, fixed blocker or open blocker), the security checklist light always reads is dropped, contradicting review-policy.md's 'a raise never dispatches less than light did'.
evidence: Raised path calls specialistsFor(dcls, { ...i, diffLines: Math.max(runtimeLines, 50) }); security there needs SCOPE_AUTH or backend with diffLines > 100, while LIGHT_FIXED always includes security. Scratch repro (backend scope, 20 runtime lines): light -> <reader> checklists [testing,maintainability,security,performance,<reader>]; with criticalFound (step=standard) -> [testing,maintainability,performance,<reader>,adversarial,<reader>], no security.

summary: write records review_depth by recomputing the required depth at HEAD (receiptDepthAtHead) instead of the depth the review plan actually dispatched, so the queue's QUEUE_RECEIPT_DEPTH_RAISED check cannot catch a head that was reviewed below its required depth (e.g. a light pass-1 plan reused after fixes grew runtime lines past 50).
evidence: const reviewDepth = receiptDepthAtHead(repoRoot, base, ..., headSha ?? head); ... review_depth: reviewDepth — no flag or input carries the REVIEW_DEPTH line from gstack-review-plan; ship/sections/<reader>.md.tmpl says 'a repeat uses the plan run that picked it'. Help text claims 'no plan means nothing written', but receiptDepthAtHead never fails (errors fail closed to full).

summary: receiptDepthVerdict recomputes against the current origin/<base> and its registry, never the receipt's recorded review_depth.base, while docs/review-policy.md says the queue uses 'the receipt's base sha'.
evidence: grep of rd. in lib/ship-receipt-depth.ts shows only rd.gate_scan is read; baseSha = git rev-parse `${baseRef}^{commit}` then collectCommit(root, baseSha..., head).

summary: receiptDepthAtHead runs gstack-gate-diff and gstack-diff-scope against the working tree (plus untracked files) but records the result as gate_scan bound to the HEAD commit, and cmdWrite has no clean-tree check. The queue then trusts that scan for HEAD, so a committed gate relaxation hidden by an uncommitted revert is accepted at light depth.
evidence: Scratch repo: HEAD commits test.skip('a') plus a 1-line src file; the working tree reverts the skip. receiptDepthAtHead -> {depth:'light', gate_scan:{tagged:0, head:<HEAD>}}. gstack-gate-diff on the clean tree -> tagged={RH-1:1}. receiptDepthVerdict(..., head) -> {ok:true, line:'REVIEW_DEPTH: receipt=light required=light ... gate_scan@2c9cdac502cd'}. carry refuses a dirty tree (bin/gstack-ship-receipt:531); write does not.

summary: write records review_depth by recomputing it from git at HEAD (receiptDepthAtHead), not from the depth the review loop actually ran (review-log depth, gate_scan, --depth-floor). The queue recomputes the same function, so QUEUE_RECEIPT_DEPTH_RAISED cannot catch a head reviewed at a lower depth. The help text's 'no plan means nothing written' is also false, because receiptDepthAtHead always returns a record.
evidence: const reviewDepth = receiptDepthAtHead(repoRoot, base, ..., headSha ?? head); there are no other reads of review depth in cmdWrite (grep 'depth' in bin/gstack-ship-receipt shows only lines 47, 90, 102, 239 and the carry block). The help text at line 90 says 'review_depth (gstack-review-plan --json at HEAD; ... no plan means nothing written)'.
